total_debt.unit_rule: all inputs and output use the same reporting currency
total_debt.missing_value_rule: missing if any required input is missing; never substitute zero

working_capital.unit_rule: both inputs and output use the same reporting currency
working_capital.sign_convention: assets and liabilities are positive balances
working_capital.missing_value_rule: missing if either required input is missing

free_cash_flow.unit_rule: both inputs and output use the same reporting currency
free_cash_flow.sign_convention: capital_expenditure is a positive cash outflow magnitude
free_cash_flow.missing_value_rule: missing if either required input is missing

ebit.unit_rule: all inputs and output use the same reporting currency
ebit.missing_value_rule: missing if any required input is missing

ebitda.unit_rule: both inputs and output use the same reporting currency
ebitda.missing_value_rule: missing if either required input is missing

roa.unit_rule: numerator and denominator use the same reporting currency; output is a ratio
roa.sign_convention: signed net income divided by positive average assets
roa.missing_value_rule: missing if either asset endpoint or net income is missing, or average assets is zero

roe.unit_rule: numerator and denominator use the same reporting currency; output is a ratio
roe.sign_convention: signed net income divided by signed average equity
roe.missing_value_rule: missing if either equity endpoint or net income is missing, or average equity is zero

book_value_per_share.sign_convention: signed equity divided by positive shares
book_value_per_share.missing_value_rule: missing if either input is missing or shares are non-positive

asset_growth.missing_value_rule: missing if either endpoint is missing or lagged assets are zero

revenue_growth.missing_value_rule: missing if either endpoint is missing or lagged revenue is zero

inventory_turnover.unit_rule: same-currency numerator and denominator produce a ratio
inventory_turnover.sign_convention: revenue minus gross profit represents positive cost of goods sold
inventory_turnover.missing_value_rule: missing if any flow or inventory endpoint is missing, or average inventory is zero

market_cap_sec_proxy.unit_rule: shares multiplied by same-day unadjusted close produces reporting currency
market_cap_sec_proxy.sign_convention: shares and price must be positive
market_cap_sec_proxy.missing_value_rule: missing if either input is missing or non-positive

enterprise_value_sec_proxy.unit_rule: all inputs and output use the same reporting currency
enterprise_value_sec_proxy.sign_convention: debt is added and cash is subtracted
enterprise_value_sec_proxy.missing_value_rule: missing if any required input is missing
